verdict: Ads have been dark for 25 days; overdue setup work is the blocker.
narrative: All paid advertising stopped on September 16 and has not run since, meaning you received zero new leads in the last 25 days. Eight agreed setup milestones — including CRM build, conversion tracking, landing pages, and ad creative — remain incomplete, and those gaps are what's preventing a restart. Work to clear each milestone is underway now, with the goal of bringing campaigns back live before the end of October. Once ads are running again on a properly instrumented stack, you should expect lead flow to resume and cost-per-lead figures to become reliable.
